_comment: Sanitized definitions of the live Hermes cron jobs on sora (no runtime state). setup-hermes.sh creates a job only if no job with that name exists, honoring 'enabled'. $HOME in workdir expands at install. deliver 'telegram' = platform home channel.

jobs.name: orphan-reaper
jobs.prompt: Silent watchdog: reap idle/orphaned tier tmux sessions and release stuck Paperclip checkouts. Output only when it acts.

jobs.name: hermes-hygiene
jobs.prompt: Weekly Hermes storage + health hygiene: prune worktree checkpoints, VACUUM state.db when it grows past 750MB, and report doctor warnings. Silent when there's nothing to reclaim and doctor is clean.
